status: fixed before H15 scoring or fits; after prior development and V1 final results were viewed
declaration: Keep SRT and next raw closing log return; separately label later forecast time and two external market inputs; not an unchanged-information algorithm claim
source_period: 2021-09-01 to 2025-09-30; fixed Yahoo raw close and dividend snapshots
availability: each completed New York session is conservatively assigned 16:00 America/New_York plus two hours; this is a declared data-availability proxy, not historical vendor delivery evidence; early closes still use16:00

cutoffs.close: 18:00 Asia/Singapore on SRT forecast date t
cutoffs.preopen: 08:00 Asia/Singapore on the next SRT target session t+1

us_features: two gross log returns accumulated between consecutive SRT-calendar cutoffs, obtained from as-of log total-return indices; same last known US session implies zero increment; no future session or forward filling from the future
base_features: H12 gross-corrected original20x6 history; fixed SRT/STI/SORA information through t, even in the preopen arm
target: unchanged raw next close return; train residual after completed historical distributions, add only previously audited preannounced SRT distribution offset
design: base_endpoint uses last six base features; *_us uses last two US features; *_all uses last eight features; no 200-day window or added indicator grid
fitting: last15% of each outer train chooses lambda0.1/1/10 or zero residual; training-only x scaler, residual scaled but not centered, all coefficients including intercept penalized, mean SSE objective; outer full refit
budget: five configurations x three folds x (three inner fits + at most one refit), at most60 fits
evaluation: same378 original development dates, all original553/679/803 training windows; final_holdout prohibited
advance: a preopen configuration beats DivSchedule and its corresponding close-time configuration by >=1% pooled RMSE, wins>=2/3 folds against DivSchedule, MAE<=1.01*DivSchedule; all comparisons reported, including mean and base endpoint
interpretation: this is an information/timing screen, not evidence of fuzzy superiority, independent validation or profitable next-open execution
next_stage: only after positive information screen, preregister matched LSTM3/Gate2/Fuzzy2 with20x8 input at both cutoffs; keep original frozen modules unchanged
